label: Killed in Sinaloa Civil War (Sep 2024–present)
contestNote: Two-year toll (through the Sep 9, 2026 anniversary of the war's outbreak) topped 3,724 homicides, including a deadly stretch of 41 killed between Aug 31–Sep 5, 2026 (one of the conflict's worst weeks) versus a lower federal count of 30 for the same days. Nearly 4,000 people remain disappeared, with over 94% of homicide cases unresolved. Official state figures are lower.

label: Chapitos/Founders Legal Status (Sep 2026)
value: El Mayo + Ovidio + Joaquín resolved or sentenced
delta: El Mayo sentenced to life + $15B forfeiture (Jul 20, 2026); Ovidio's sentencing remains set for Oct 28, 2026; Joaquín's sentencing-prep hearing postponed again (Aug 21) to Mar 1, 2027; Iván & Alfredo still fugitive as of the Sep 9, 2026 two-year war anniversary, reportedly negotiating surrender since ~2025 with no confirmed deal
